name: soundfonts
character: The SoundFont banks this skill can play, with where each comes from, its licence, its size and how to check it. Only generaluser_gs is needed; every other bank is optional and is fetched with `python scripts/setup_project.py --soundfonts <name>`.
status_note: Written 2026-11-23 from an environment whose network allowed neither GitHub downloads nor the other hosts, so NO download URL below was fetched and no checksum was taken from a download. A sha256 is filled only where the file was on disk here (generaluser_gs, timgm6mb); the others are null, and setup_project.py then records the hash of what it downloaded on first use (assets/soundfonts/INSTALLED.json) and checks every later run against it. Sizes marked approximate are the figures given in the request, not measurements.
